name: Hiram
summary: The king of Tyre and a friend to both David and Solomon. He sent cedar wood and skilled workers for their building, and his ships brought gold from Ophir.

key_moments.title: Sends Builders to David
key_moments.description: Hiram sent messengers to David with cedar trees, carpenters and masons. They built David a house.

key_moments.title: Sends Cedar for the Temple
key_moments.description: When Solomon asked for help building a house for the LORD, Hiram rejoiced and blessed the LORD. He sent cedar and fir trees, Solomon paid him in wheat and oil, and the two kings made a league of peace.

key_moments.title: Sends His Sailors to Ophir
key_moments.description: Hiram sent his own sailors, men who knew the sea, with Solomon's servants. They sailed to Ophir and brought back gold for King Solomon.
